recomputed.scope: full clip (all tau), not only the exported window

world: Each tau is an independent VGGT inference whose world frame is view 1's camera at that tau (VGGT predicts E_v1 ~= [I|0], max deviation ~3e-3). If view 1 is static this equals view 1 at tau=0; view 1 is not guaranteed static (see rotDeg of v2 for how much the other camera moves relative to it). Cameras: x_cam = R x_world + t (OpenCV, +z forward); C = -R^T t is the camera center. K is normalized: row 0 divided by imgSize[0] (W), row 1 by imgSize[1] (H) of the VGGT input image. Units are VGGT's normalized scene scale and differ slightly between keyframes.
pts: [x,y,z,r,g,b,res]: up to N points sampled uniformly (seeded) from the pixels the metric scatters (finite depth, not flying pixels), world coords from the metric's point map (unproject of the aligned depth). rgb from VGGT's resized input. res = min(1, |d - d_rendered| / d~ / 0.2) on ROI pixels, -1 outside the ROI (not scored). Most ROI pixels have res 0 because the view's own point wins the z-buffer; nonzero res marks pixels where another view's surface lands in front.
pngs: depth: aligned depth, turbo map over [depthRange] (2nd-98th pct), transparent where the pixel is not scattered. resid: same res as pts on a green-yellow-red ramp (0 to 0.2 relative depth error), transparent outside ROI. Both area-downsampled to 192px wide.
